sourceName: National Health and Aging Trends Study
protocolPurpose: Pre-register the R13/R14 cohort-flow, endpoint-routing, survey-design and disclosure-control protocol that must exist before any NHATS extraction script, weighted metric, calibration, validation or public Web output.

currentDecision.reason: The required route classes and output contracts are pre-registered, but registration, exact variables, missing codes, endpoint fields, survey-design variables, cohort-flow evidence and disclosure-control validation remain incomplete.

officialSourceFacts.fact: NHATS Cross-Year Search is a Colectica metadata database that includes item numbers, variable names, labels, values, value labels and question text after separate registration.
officialSourceFacts.modelConsequence: No cohort-flow or endpoint route may be computed from candidate prose names; every route field must be confirmed from Colectica, codebooks or official crosswalks.

officialSourceFacts.fact: NHATS/NSOC Conditions of Use require aggregate statistical reporting, prohibit unapproved sharing, and prohibit uploading NHATS/NSOC data to public LLM or AI platforms.
officialSourceFacts.modelConsequence: Only aggregate non-disclosive route counts can leave a governed workspace; public AI systems may receive public documentation, synthetic examples or approved aggregate outputs only.

officialSourceFacts.fact: Sensitive-data tabulations with fewer than five observations require suppression or additional restriction handling under the NHATS/NSOC Conditions of Use.
officialSourceFacts.modelConsequence: Cohort-flow and endpoint-route outputs must pass a small-cell disclosure gate before public export.

officialSourceFacts.fact: The Rounds 1-14 User Guide documents variable naming conventions, public-use file structure and standard negative-value missingness codes.
officialSourceFacts.modelConsequence: Every endpoint route must distinguish real endpoint states from refusal, don't know, inapplicable, missing, proxy, route and skip-pattern states before metrics.

officialSourceFacts.fact: NHATS sample design and weighting documentation describes analytic weights, strata, PSU/cluster and variance approaches.
officialSourceFacts.modelConsequence: Weighted route counts or population summaries are blocked until the analysis weight, strata, PSU/cluster and variance method are fixed.

officialSourceFacts.fact: The R13 and R14 file pages list public annual file families, public clock drawing image resources, and sensitive resources with separate application requirements.
officialSourceFacts.modelConsequence: The first route protocol is limited to the candidate public annual R13/R14 path until registration, canonical format selection and file-tier constraints are complete.

cohortFlowRows.label: Official source refresh
cohortFlowRows.requiredEvidence: Date-stamped review of NHATS Data Access, Conditions of Use, Cross-Year Search, R13/R14 file pages, User Guide and Technical Paper 55.

cohortFlowRows.label: Registered access boundary
cohortFlowRows.requiredEvidence: Registered NHATS account, permitted user boundary and data-sharing obligations recorded outside the public repository.

cohortFlowRows.label: Canonical R13 public annual file
cohortFlowRows.requiredEvidence: One R13 public annual file format selected with release path, access tier, storage boundary and no-public-AI rule.

cohortFlowRows.label: Canonical R14 public annual file
cohortFlowRows.requiredEvidence: One R14 public annual file format selected with release path, access tier, storage boundary and no-public-AI rule.

cohortFlowRows.label: R13 baseline eligible candidates
cohortFlowRows.requiredEvidence: R13 sample-person eligibility, age frame, interview route, residence route, public-use field tier and design identity fields confirmed.

cohortFlowRows.label: R13 design and identity readiness
cohortFlowRows.requiredEvidence: Join key, round identifier, cohort flag, interview status, analysis weight, strata and PSU/cluster fields confirmed.

cohortFlowRows.label: R13-to-R14 linkage
cohortFlowRows.requiredEvidence: Official join key, follow-up status categories, route variables and allowed public-use linkage boundary confirmed.

cohortFlowRows.label: R14 endpoint route counts
cohortFlowRows.requiredEvidence: R14 alive, proxy, known-alive-not-interviewed, residential/facility, decedent/death-boundary, missing and restricted routes mapped to confirmed fields.

cohortFlowRows.label: Survey design readiness
cohortFlowRows.requiredEvidence: Analysis weight, strata, PSU/cluster, variance method and population inference boundary fixed before weighted metrics.

cohortFlowRows.label: Disclosure control readiness
cohortFlowRows.requiredEvidence: Aggregate-only export, n < 5 suppression, no row-level output and public-AI upload exclusion validator implemented.

endpointRouteClasses.meaning: R14 route where the sample person is alive and represented by a direct self interview.
endpointRouteClasses.requiredEvidence: Confirmed R14 interview-status and self-route value labels.

endpointRouteClasses.meaning: R14 route where the sample person is alive and represented by a proxy interview or proxy measurement route.
endpointRouteClasses.requiredEvidence: Confirmed proxy route variables, value labels and substitution rules.

endpointRouteClasses.meaning: R14 route where the sample person is known or inferred alive but does not have a usable interview for endpoint component construction.
endpointRouteClasses.requiredEvidence: Confirmed status categories distinguishing alive noninterview from refusal, missing, inapplicable and death boundary.

endpointRouteClasses.meaning: R14 route where residential care, facility or nursing-home context changes the functional-survival interpretation.
endpointRouteClasses.requiredEvidence: Confirmed residential/facility route variables, public-use tier and endpoint aggregation rule.

endpointRouteClasses.meaning: R14 route where the endpoint boundary is death or a decedent status allowed by public-use fields.
endpointRouteClasses.requiredEvidence: Confirmed death/decedent flag, file tier, value labels and no individual death-date output rule.

endpointRouteClasses.meaning: Rows that cannot be safely assigned to a functional-survival route because missingness, skip logic, nonresponse or value labels remain unresolved.
endpointRouteClasses.requiredEvidence: Complete negative-code and skip-logic map for every selected field.

endpointRouteClasses.meaning: Rows or route detail that would require sensitive or restricted NHATS files not approved for the first public-use pass.
endpointRouteClasses.requiredEvidence: File-tier table linking the route to sensitive or restricted resources and an exclusion rule.

endpointRouteClasses.meaning: Aggregate route cells that cannot be publicly exported because disclosure control flags cell size or sensitivity concerns.
endpointRouteClasses.requiredEvidence: Disclosure-control validator result with small-cell threshold and export decision.

analysisOutputContracts.meaning: Aggregate count table for every cohort-flow row from source refresh through disclosure control.
Aggregate count table for R14 endpoint-route classes after confirmed route mapping.
Aggregate missingness and not-classifiable route table for selected variables and endpoint classes.
Documentation artifact fixing weight, strata, PSU/cluster and variance method before weighted route outputs.
Pre-export validation artifact for aggregate-only, n < 5 suppression, no row-level export and no public AI upload.
Aggregate distribution of the pre-registered functional-survival outcome after all gates are ready.

disclosureControl.smallCellRule: Counts below 5 must not be publicly exported; sensitive-data magnitude or frequency tabulations with n < 5 require suppression or additional restriction handling.

readinessGates.requiredEvidence: Fresh official page review before any download, extraction or route mapping.
Registered user and permitted-use boundary confirmed outside the public repository.
One canonical R13 and one canonical R14 public annual format selected with governed storage boundary.
Every cohort-flow and endpoint route field confirmed from Colectica, codebook or official crosswalk.
Negative missing codes, skip logic, proxy route and not-classifiable rules mapped for all selected fields.
Alive, proxy, known-alive-not-interviewed, residential/facility, death boundary, missing, restricted and suppressed routes mapped.
Analysis weight, strata, PSU/cluster and variance method fixed before weighted metrics.
Aggregate-only, small-cell suppression and no-public-AI export validator implemented.
Non-public raw/derived storage, access log and destruction-on-request process defined.

prohibitedActions: download NHATS files from this route protocol
write extraction scripts before route fields and missing codes are confirmed
compute endpoint routing from candidate field names
upload raw, row-level or derived disclosive NHATS data to public AI systems
claim calibration, validation, treatment effect or clinical usefulness
nextWork: Confirm exact Colectica route fields and value labels for R13/R14 identity, interview status, follow-up status, proxy, residential/facility and death-boundary variables.
Select canonical public annual R13/R14 files after registration and governed-storage setup.
Fill a cohort-flow count table only after route fields, missingness and file tiers are confirmed.
Build a missingness and endpoint-route map before any functional-survival metric.
Implement the disclosure-control validator before public export.
Fix survey-design weight, strata, PSU/cluster and variance method before weighted summaries.
